verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a locally run, open-source CLI secret scanner for git repos, directories and stdin. Nothing in the evidence shows it sends user data to an AI service or trains models, so an AI-training opt-out control is a category error for this product type. No evidence shows it ships any AI or data-collection feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
